edit_file_or_folder_name.description: Rename a file or a folder in the object's file storage and change its description.

params.obj_id: ID of the folder or the identifier of the file
params.obj_type: Object type: folder — a folder, anything else — a file
params.name: New name

new_library_file.description: Register an uploaded file in the object's media library: binds an already accepted file to a folder or an object and sets its display name.

params.obj_id: ID of the object or folder the file is added to
params.obj_type: Object type: project, community, user, folder and other site object types
params.name: File name in the storage

delete_library_file.description: Delete a file from the media library together with the file on disk.

params.obj_id: Identifier of the file in the storage

delete_conversation_file.description: Delete a file attached to a message: it is detached from the message and removed from disk.

params.obj_id: Identifier of the file in the storage

create_folder.description: Create a folder in the object's file storage.

params.obj_id: ID of the object or the parent folder
params.obj_type: Object type: project, community, user, folder and other site object types
params.name: Folder name

delete_folder.description: Delete a file storage folder together with its contents.

add_link.description: Add a link to an external resource into the object's file storage — it is shown next to the files.

params.obj_id: ID of the object or folder the link is added to
params.obj_type: Object type: project, community, user, folder and other site object types
params.name: Link title

delete_link.description: Delete a link from the object's file storage.

load_disk.description: Get the contents of the object's file storage: folders, files and links available to the current user. Changes nothing.

params.obj_id: ID of the object or the folder
params.obj_type: Object type: project, community, user, folder and other site object types

load_library.description: Get the object's media library — photos and videos. Changes nothing.

params.obj_type: Object type: project, community, user, calendar_event and other site object types
params.external: true returns the library in the form used for embedding on an external page

move_file_to_folder.description: Move a file into another folder of the file storage.

params.file_id: ID of the file being moved
params.parent_obj: true — move to the storage root of the object instead of a nested folder

change_folder_rights.description: Set the list of users granted access to a folder. The list given replaces the previous one.

params.users_list: IDs of the users being granted access
